33 DOGS. A FLIGHT FOR THEIR FUTURE. 🐾✈️

Sometimes the most important cargo has paws.

Pilots To The Rescue’s mission log records a November 8 flight carrying 33 dogs, with an itinerary from Fairfield, New Jersey, to Centerville, Tennessee, then Buffalo, New York, and back to Fairfield.

The organization lists eight receiving rescue groups for the mission, including Nickel City Canine Rescue, 7 Hearts Maternity Rescue and Heart of Niagara Animal Rescue.

This is aviation connecting people who can help: pilots, transport coordinators and rescue partners working together to give animals a better chance at adoption.

The flight is one part of the journey. The care, fostering and work toward finding homes continue on the ground.

Here’s to every person who helps turn a flight plan into a new possibility for a dog. 💛

Source: Pilots To The Rescue, mission log for November 8, 2026, checked November 14.
